name: chart-pie
title: Pie Chart
description: Three dark chart cards: a donut with a total in its hole, an interactive donut whose value changes with a month selector, and a pie with value labels on each slice.
use: A dashboard needs to show a simple part-to-whole split in a compact card.
avoid: Charts hardcode browser and month data, so real figures need the source arrays replaced.
a11y: The month picker is keyboard reachable, but slices have no roles or names and tooltips are pointer-only. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three bordered dark cards hold grey pie charts. The first two are donuts with big centre numbers and a Visitors caption, the third a full pie with number labels around the rim.
behaves: The sectors sweep in when the cards appear. Choosing a month in the second card re-highlights its slice and updates the centre number, while hovering any slice shows a tooltip.
customise: Each variant hardcodes its data, titles and chart config; adapting means replacing arrays and labels in the file.
weight: light: Three small SVG pie charts with a short draw-in; no continuous loop.
